thread:
yvonne: heads up - onboarding quickstart failing in CI for new hires. sampleapp does: create route + warm embeddings. curl works but SDK fails on the first PATCH in the script.

diego: what error?

yvonne: SDK v2.0.0 PATCH /routes/r_test returns 400 unknown parameter: priority

samir: do you have the outgoing body from the SDK?

yvonne: yup. curl payload: {
  "name": "demo",
  "priority": 10,
  "warm_embeddings": true
}

SDK payload logged: {
  "name": "demo",
  "priority": "10"
}

samir: aha two things: SDK is casting numeric fields to strings for some reason (seen in recent serializer change) and it's dropping warm_embeddings (experimental flag) because it isn't in the typed interface. curl plain JSON works.

diego: also saw that if auth refresh triggers mid-request the SDK retries the PATCH and we sometimes see two updates in Dedicated. curl doesn't retry so users don't see duplicates.

yvonne: so three problems: param type drift (number -> string), unknown-key filtering, and unsafe retry for mutating endpoint. this blocks onboarding runs.

samir: short-term mitigation options: 1) revert the serializer change that coerces numbers to strings, 2) preserve unknown top-level keys under a passthrough bag (e.g. _extra) or stop filtering, 3) add idempotency-key generation for mutating calls or disable retry for non-idempotent methods.

diego: agree. for immediate patch i'd prefer: revert number coercion + add passthrough for unknown keys + generate Idempotency-Key header when retrying POST/PATCH/PUT. we'll put a warning log when passthrough happens.

yvonne: can we also add a tiny e2e in sampleapp CI that posts warm_embeddings and asserts the server saw it? helps catch regressions.

release-bot: created RDW-1499: "sdk coerces numbers to strings + filters experimental flags + unsafe retry causing duplicate updates" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-1499 :white_check_mark:

samir: i'll open a PR for the serializer revert and passthrough tonight. diego can you add the idempotency helper and the CI test?

diego: yep. i'll also add a one-line note to quickstart explaining temporary workaround: set Idempotency-Key header to avoid duplicates.

yvonne: thanks. small DX regressions but huge first-impression impact for new users. :thumbsup:
